id.title: Id

parentId.title: Parentid
parentId.description: ID of an actual composite material parent in this document; null for ALL standalone questions. Never use a section heading or previous standalone question as parent.

questionKind.title: Questionkind
questionKind.description: Null for ordinary choice, true_false, fill_blank, short_answer, ordering, matching. Specialized kind only when explicitly supported; must match answerMode. Never propagate a parent kind to a child.

sourceLanguage.title: Sourcelanguage
sourceLanguage.description: Only for translation and only when source direction is explicit; null for ordinary questions and writing.

targetLanguage.title: Targetlanguage
targetLanguage.description: Only for translation/writing; explicit in English means en, in Chinese means zh. Null for other kinds or absent direction.

minWords.title: Minwords
minWords.description: Only explicitly printed writing word limits; null otherwise. Do not supply 0 as an absent value.

maxWords.title: Maxwords

passage.title: Passage
passage.description: Shared material ONLY for reading, word_bank, cloze, listening, gap_fill parents. Empty for standalone questions and children. Listening transcript belongs in transcript instead. Replace the entire printed gap marker, including its local number, with one blank block; never leave the marker number in adjacent text.

blankCount.title: Blankcount
blankCount.description: Positive number ONLY for fill_blank children or standalone fill blanks; null for all other modes, including composite parents.

stem.title: Stem
stem.description: Remove only the leading question number and exercise-type prefix, then preserve the printed exercise title or question wording literally; do not substitute a generic exercise name. This applies to composite parent titles too; keep the separate passage out of stem. When a gap child has no printed prompt, use its local source wording or hint, not just the gap number. For example, a gap in 'Ice is [1]' has stem 'Ice is', not '1'.

matchingVariant.title: Matchingvariant
